reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

notes: Every guide-cited item and every /facts line checked out against its source, so there are no flags. Several items rest on type-derived facts that contradict the guide and the 19 October evidence. Per the instructions these are not flagged, but a human should reconcile them. (1) /configuration/20 and /states/2 rest on /facts/props/9, which says buttonDisabled disables the default footer button. The guide's states section says "The card can’t disable its button", and the evidence contract says there is "no way to disable the footer Button". (2) /configuration/17, /configuration/18 and /configuration/19 rest on /facts/props/7, /facts/props/1 and /facts/props/5, which say there is no placeholder bank name, row copy or button. The guide's sources section says "without other props it shows placeholder copy". The evidence lists the defaults 'State Bank of India', three 'Korem ipsum' rows and 'Button'. (3) /configuration/21 rests on /facts/props/13, which says disableTruncation reaches the header name, badge, row values and footer button. The evidence says it covers "value text only" and "doesn't reach the header name, badge or button". These type facts probably come from a newer build than the guide checked (Biscuit's ace46ca/dbe0e02 changes for #344). The evidence says this guide's copy wasn't re-checked against those changes and waits for #344's own publish. Either the guide needs re-checking or the entry is mixing builds. (4) /accessibility/0 says accessibilityLabel 'labels the card region', which follows the declared type text. The evidence notes the label sits on a role-less root div, so it may not be exposed as a region. (5) Minor: /content/rules/8 gives the Do caption ('institutionAvatar shows the bank’s own mark') as its reason. The guide's actual reason against leaving out the logo is the Don't caption: 'The card falls back to a stranger’s photo.'
